research_question: Can two independently windowed prior-only ridge models learn a stable nonlinear-free mapping from completed price, volatility, quote-volume, taker-flow and cross-market residual state to four-hour after-cost direction, with a separate fifteen-minute execution confirmation?

sources: walk-forward financial machine learning and purged temporal validation
market-impact, order-flow and volatility-state prediction research
reused: matured labels only and embargo at each monthly boundary
prior validation determines whether a model is active and its prediction threshold
separate execution confirmation and structural invalidation

scenario.context: every completed thirty-minute bar supplies multi-horizon returns, volatility, range, volume, taker-flow, time-of-day and cross-sectional residual features
scenario.state: a 180-day and a 365-day ridge model are each trained only on matured prior labels; both prior validation slices must be economically positive and their current predictions must agree in direction
scenario.confirmation: the next completed fifteen-minute bar extends in the predicted direction with a directional body and aligned taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: outside the current thirty-minute event extreme plus ten percent of prior thirty-minute ATR
scenario.management: trail the best completed thirty-minute close by one and a half prior ATRs
scenario.arbitration: one global open position; select the largest conservative ensemble prediction

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: features use completed rows; four-hour labels mature eight thirty-minute bars later; monthly model fitting excludes every label whose end is not strictly before the prediction month

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only the unchanged ensemble passing every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune windows, features, ridge penalty, validation activation, confirmation or stop rules after evaluation.
